surfaces.coverage: M0.1 inspection of repository metadata visible through the configured integration, exact compiler candidate and draft pull request state, migration branch heads, tracked workflow blobs, rulesets, and releases. limitations: Status inspected applies only to the stated M0.1 coverage. Administration-only classic branch protection and repository Actions policy remain unverified and are not converted into inspected facts.
The 36-hour maximum bounds fast-moving repository-state evidence to one review cycle; it is not a guarantee that the state remained unchanged.

At owner acceptance and pre-integration, a read-only checkpoint assessment must compare candidate PR state and head/base identities, migration branch heads, tracked workflow blobs, visible repository settings, rulesets, and releases with this snapshot. Candidate PR differences supply candidate_pull_request_changed; migration branch-head differences supply source_repository_branches_changed; tracked workflow-blob differences supply source_repository_workflows_changed; visible repository-setting or ruleset differences supply source_repository_settings_changed; and release-collection differences supply source_repository_releases_changed. Inability to complete any required comparison supplies checkpoint_assessment_unavailable and fails closed.

An unchanged checkpoint assessment must be retained with the applicable decision or integration record. A changed result requires a replacement observation, renewed evidence binding, and renewed disposition.
